issues.description: image.tobytes() with format='RGB' produces wrong bytes when PIL decodes as RGBA, P, or L
issues.detail: Gemini returns PNG/JPEG which PIL may open in RGBA, palette, or grayscale mode. Calling tobytes() without converting and labeling the frame format='RGB' yields a buffer whose size and channel layout don't match the declared format. Downstream consumers will render garbage or crash. Fix: image.convert('RGB').tobytes().

issues.description: Module-import monkey-patch of private genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE is a load-bearing hack
issues.detail: Mutating a private underscore-prefixed attribute of google-genai at import time is a global side effect affecting every consumer in the process. The self-labeled 'temporary hack' will silently break when the attribute is renamed upstream. File a bug, pin the version, or use a supported API.

issues.description: Image-model detection by substring 'image' in model name is fragile
issues.detail: `'image' in self._model_name` will misfire on future models containing the substring (imagen, image-understanding, vision-image-preview) and silently toggle thinking budget. Replace with an explicit capability table or allowlist so the rule is obvious and auditable.

issues.description: Default model bump from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent behavior change piggybacked on a feature PR
issues.detail: Existing callers relying on the default get different cost, latency, and output on next deploy. The CHANGELOG notes it, but coupling it to image-generation makes the change hard to revert independently. Split into its own PR with a migration note.

issues.description: No error handling around Image.open of arbitrary server-returned inline_data bytes
issues.detail: If the SDK returns malformed bytes or non-image inline_data (audio/video/partial), PIL raises UnidentifiedImageError and the entire context-processing loop dies. Wrap in try/except, inspect part.inline_data.mime_type, log failures, and continue processing remaining parts.

issues.description: No test accompanies the new inline_data to OutputImageRawFrame branch
issues.detail: A small unit test that feeds a synthetic inline_data part (including RGBA mode) and asserts an OutputImageRawFrame with correct size and channel layout would have caught the RGB conversion bug. Add coverage for the new emission path.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a small feature PR with two real correctness bugs that must block landing: a module-import-time monkey-patch of a private google-genai attribute (READ_BUFFER_SIZE), and a PIL-to-raw-bytes conversion that declares format='RGB' without converting the image, which will produce malformed buffers for RGBA or palette-mode images Gemini returns. Secondary concerns are a substring-based image-model detection that will misfire on future models, a silent default-model bump piggybacked on the feature, and absent error handling around Image.open of arbitrary server bytes. Add image.convert('RGB'), remove or properly fix the buffer-size hack, replace substring sniffing with a capability check, split the default-model change, and add a unit test for the new branch.
